authorityCeiling.basis: Boundary: "Human override and protected constitutional memory remain explicit." FounderOS carries the human override, the top authority in the organism, and Section 3.3 lists emergency block as the top authority level, so its ceiling is emergency-block.

Boundary quote: "Human override and protected constitutional memory remain explicit." Human override is the top authority in the organism, which maps to emergency-block, the top level in the Section 3.3 authority vocabulary.

capabilityFamilies.basis: Role quote: "Displays time-indexed topology, decisions, constraints, and outcomes." Boundary quote: "Human override and protected constitutional memory remain explicit."

lifecycleStages.basis: Section 3.3 defines lifecycleMask as workflow stage and completion state but names no stages. The paper assigns no lifecycle stages to FounderOS / Universal Timeline.

memoryPlanes.basis: Role quote: "Displays time-indexed topology, decisions, constraints, and outcomes." Boundary quote: "protected constitutional memory." Time-indexed decisions are episodic records, outcomes map to the outcome plane, and protected constitutional memory maps to the founder plane in the Section 3.3 memory vocabulary.

outputClasses.basis: Role quote: "Displays time-indexed topology, decisions, constraints, and outcomes." A displayed timeline view is a recorded artifact.

permittedRoutes.basis: The paper defines routeMask semantics in Sections 3.2 and 3.3 but names no per-organ routes for FounderOS / Universal Timeline.
